title: Role of abscisic acid receptor PYLs in mediating stress resistance of Zostera marina.
authors: Li, Huijiao; Liu, Yuechen; Wu, Meng; Chang, Yizeng; Gao, Yaping; Fu, Xianjun; Zhang, Lei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究大叶藻ABA受体PYL家族与ABA结合及PPI互作，虽含分子模拟但对象为蛋白-激素而非蛋白-DNA，仅提及MYB/NAC转录因子调控表达，无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联弱。
abstract: Abscisic acid (ABA), a pivotal plant hormone, regulates seed dormancy and germination, promotes leaf senescence and abscission, while enhancing plant stress resistance. The pyrabactin resistance 1-like (PYR/PYL) proteins function as core regulators in the ABA signaling transduction pathway. Despite Z. marina has ecological and economic benefits, there has been no research on its ZosmaPYL family so far. This study identified six ZosmaPYLs, all of which contain conserved ABA-binding gate and latch domains. Promoter analysis revealed ABA-responsive cis-elements in the ZosmaPYLs. Differential expression patterns of ZomaPYLs were observed across various tissues and under ABA stress conditions. Molecular simulations and surface plasmon resonance (SPR) verified the affinity between ZosmaPYLs and ABA, revealing that six ZosmaPYLs exhibit distinct affinities for ABA. Protein-protein interaction (PPI) network analysis revealed ZosmaPP2C3/4 interactions with all ZosmaPYLs, whereas yeast two-hybrid (Y2H) assays validate ABA-dependent binding between specific ZosmaPYLs and ZosmaPP2C3/4. The transcriptome data revealed that ABA stress induces organ-specific transcriptional remodeling in Z. marina leaves (photosynthesis) and roots (transport or antioxidants), MYB and NAC transcription factors (TFs) target-regulated ZosmaPYLs expression. These results suggest that ZosmaPYLs serve as a central regulator that connects ABA perception with stress-responsive pathways in Z. marina.
abstract_zh: 脱落酸（ABA）作为一种关键的植物激素，调控种子休眠与萌发，促进叶片衰老与脱落，同时增强植物抗逆性。抗吡菌素1类似（PYR/PYL）蛋白在ABA信号转导途径中充当核心调控因子。尽管大叶藻（Z. marina）具有生态和经济价值，但迄今为止对其ZosmaPYL家族尚无研究。本研究鉴定了六个ZosmaPYLs，所有成员均含有保守的ABA结合门控和锁扣结构域。启动子分析揭示了ZosmaPYLs中存在ABA响应性顺式作用元件。在不同组织及ABA胁迫条件下，观察到ZosmaPYLs的差异表达模式。分子模拟和表面等离子体共振（SPR）验证了ZosmaPYLs与ABA之间的亲和力，揭示六个ZosmaPYLs对ABA表现出不同的亲和性。蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络分析显示ZosmaPP2C3/4与所有ZosmaPYLs存在相互作用，而酵母双杂交（Y2H）实验验证了特定ZosmaPYLs与ZosmaPP2C3/4之间的ABA依赖性结合。转录组数据显示，ABA胁迫诱导大叶藻叶片（光合作用）和根（运输或抗氧化）中器官特异性转录重塑，MYB和NAC转录因子（TFs）靶向调控ZosmaPYLs表达。这些结果表明，ZosmaPYLs作为连接ABA感知与大叶藻胁迫响应途径的中心调控因子。
